summary_template.description: Template for test design summary section with all metrics and statistics

metadata.generator_version: version of the test design generator
input_sources: list of input files used for generation

summary.total_tests_generated: total count of all tests across all types
summary.boundary_tests_count: count of boundary value analysis tests
summary.contract_tests_count: count of API contract compliance tests
summary.coverage_percentage: percentage of requirements with at least one test (0-100)
summary.requirements_covered: count of requirements that have at least one test

traceability_matrix.description: Bidirectional mapping between tests and source artifacts

REQ-XXX: list of test IDs validating this requirement

VAL-XXX: list of test IDs exercising this validation rule

API-XXX: list of test IDs validating this API contract

REQ-XXX.test_count: number of tests covering this requirement

VAL-XXX.test_count: number of tests covering this validation

API-XXX.test_count: number of tests covering this API

gaps_report.description: Identifies coverage gaps and incomplete items
missing_validations: list of validation rules without test coverage
incomplete_requirements: list of requirements with no tests or partial coverage
uncovered_requirements: list of requirements with 0 test coverage
uncovered_validations: list of validations with 0 test coverage
gaps_report.notes: summary notes about overall coverage health and recommendations

for_100_percent_coverage: Ensure each requirement has at least 1 positive test and 1 negative test
Ensure each validation rule has at least 1 validation test or boundary test
Ensure each API endpoint has at least 1 contract test
Include boundary value tests for all numeric and date constraints

metrics_interpretation.coverage_percentage: Target 100%. Lower values indicate incomplete requirement coverage.
metrics_interpretation.positive_to_negative_ratio: Typically 1:1 or 1:2. More negative tests improve error path coverage.
metrics_interpretation.boundary_test_presence: Critical for numeric, date, and string length constraints.
metrics_interpretation.contract_test_presence: Essential when API specifications are provided.

quality_indicators: All requirements referenced in tests (bidirectional traceability)
No orphaned tests (every test traces back to a requirement or validation)
Test distribution includes positive, negative, and boundary tests
Gaps report is empty or notes are constructive
